title: Read Rayuela grades by academic year
notes: The live authenticated menu and selectors exposed a definitive empty current year and populated grade tables for two listed historical years. Prior work in 8d91c98 contains a reader and sanitized fixtures.
done_when: The CLI reads the current and a selected historical academic year and checks that the portal applied the requested year.
result: Read Rayuela grades by academic year
evidence: After pnpm build, rayuela calificaciones read the live default year and six advertised years. Two requested prior years matched the returned selection and had five subject rows each. The text-grade year matched all 15 nonempty grades in the source table; the other year had no grade text and displayed separate observation icons. Tests cover an ignored year selector.
